other_reading: Round the stored numbers to a coarser unit such as the nearest ten or hundred, which would change the stored values in B2:G11.
reading_followed: Display the numbers in B2:G11 as whole numbers, which leaves every stored value (already whole integers) unchanged.
notes: Every value in B2:G11 is already a whole integer with General format, so the whole-number reading changes no readable state and the readers cannot check display format. Confidence is low because the request does not say what unit to round to.
